attributions.surface_quote: The heat I was experiencing came from within myself. It was wrath and impotence.

canonical_statement: Individual intent can be utilized as a defensive mechanism against predatory metaphysical entities.

attributions.surface_quote: I had my wrath, my unbending intent, not to let them eat me.

canonical_statement: The human psyche possesses a core, immutable identity that persists even when the peripheral personality undergoes fragmentation.

attributions.surface_quote: a core fragment of myself that remained cohesive: the me of my childhood.

canonical_statement: Entry into the infinite is a state of being that requires an act of intent rather than a rational decision.

attributions.surface_quote: your decision to stay or to return is not a matter of a reasonable choice, but a matter of intending it.

canonical_statement: The state of infinity acts as a terminal destination from which return to the mundane world is possible only through the exercise of individual will.

attributions.surface_quote: Once you have entered into infinity, you can't depend on us to bring you back.

canonical_statement: The mundane world is characterized by disorder, compulsion, noise, and pain, contrasting with the nature of the infinite.

attributions.surface_quote: to return to the world of disorder, compulsion, noise, and pain is a most unappealing affair.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is defined by an immutable essence that persists across different physical forms and lifetimes.

attributions.surface_quote: What was left intact was their essence.

canonical_statement: Human awareness is a vertical structure that must be developed and stabilized to be reliable.

attributions.surface_quote: Awareness grows like a column from the ground up.

canonical_statement: The human condition is fundamentally solitary, though this solitude is distinct from the emotional state of loneliness.

attributions.surface_quote: We are alone; that's our condition, but to die alone is not to die in loneliness.

canonical_statement: Consciousness is capable of shifting between discrete levels, with memory often failing to bridge these transitions.

attributions.surface_quote: You easily lose your grip on your new awareness and forget everything.

canonical_statement: Knowledge can exist in a state of 'inner silence' prior to its formulation into linguistic or rational thought.

attributions.surface_quote: Act on your inner silence, on what you know without knowing.

canonical_statement: The energetic burden of social and personal indebtedness persists beyond the physical interaction and must be consciously resolved to achieve freedom.

attributions.surface_quote: I was far from being free of indebtedness. How about your ghosts?

canonical_statement: The process of recapitulation allows an individual to identify and settle energetic debts incurred throughout their life.

attributions.surface_quote: I had recapitulated my life to such an extent that I had not left a single stone unturned.

canonical_statement: Human perception can detect the presence of others through energetic sensing rather than visual observation.

attributions.surface_quote: I had caught the difference between the bushes and his silhouette by feeling rather than sight.

canonical_statement: The natural environment possesses an inherent capacity to provide sustenance and resources to those who possess the knowledge to access it.

attributions.surface_quote: He could have drawn from that jungle anything he wanted.

canonical_statement: The state of an object or organism, specifically its integrity, determines its metaphysical or medicinal efficacy.

attributions.surface_quote: The meat lost its curative value if the vulture was killed by violence.

canonical_statement: The physical body of a species is not a vector for the transmission of illness to human beings.

attributions.surface_quote: Donkey's diseases cannot be transmitted to man.

canonical_statement: Solitude is a psychological state of the mind, whereas solitariness is a physical state of being.

attributions.surface_quote: Solitude for me is psychological, of the mind. Solitariness is physical.

canonical_statement: Psychological solitude is inherently debilitating, while physical solitariness is inherently comforting.

attributions.surface_quote: One is debilitating, the other comforting.

canonical_statement: An individual can voluntarily accept the karmic or existential burden of another to prevent their self-destruction.

attributions.surface_quote: I know that I will die, but my father won't.

canonical_statement: The majority of human beings exist in a state of spiritual or existential death, characterized by a lack of essential courage.

attributions.surface_quote: As far as I was concerned, every one of them was dead.

canonical_statement: The capacity to live meaningfully is contingent upon the possession of a cause for which one is willing to die.

attributions.surface_quote: We must have something we could die for before we can think we have something to live for.

canonical_statement: Death serves as the governing principle or primary orientation for the structure of human life.

attributions.surface_quote: The two go hand in hand, with death at the helm.

canonical_statement: An individual's life can be fundamentally transferred to another through an act of existential salvation.

attributions.surface_quote: His life had ended the day of the lynching... it belonged to her.

canonical_statement: Human vitality is an internal state that distinguishes individuals from those who are spiritually or existentially stagnant.

attributions.surface_quote: every one of the members of my family were corpses that walked, he was alive

canonical_statement: The identity and continued existence of an individual can be fundamentally tethered to the presence of another person.

attributions.surface_quote: If I didn't have my mother, I wouldn't live.

canonical_statement: An individual's identity is the cumulative result of their progenitor's life experiences and actions.

attributions.surface_quote: You are the sum total of everything that I have done in this life.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousnesses are destined to reunite after the separation caused by physical death.

attributions.surface_quote: In the end, we will be together again anyway.

canonical_statement: Time operates as an autonomous force, independent of human desire or intervention.

attributions.surface_quote: Time is independent of our wishes.

canonical_statement: The physical world and human events are constructed or scripted like a theatrical production.

attributions.surface_quote: It seemed to have been concocted, written down somewhere.

canonical_statement: Human existence is defined by a finite temporal duration.

attributions.surface_quote: we do run out of time

canonical_statement: The Earth is the fundamental substrate and matrix of all human consciousness and action.

attributions.surface_quote: Earth, the mother, the matrix, the epicenter of everything we are

canonical_statement: The Earth is a sentient being capable of reciprocal interaction with human intent.

attributions.surface_quote: the earth acknowledged Genaro's gesture

canonical_statement: Human awareness can be shifted or localized within the physical body, affecting emotional states.

attributions.surface_quote: your awareness is on your toes again

canonical_statement: Transitioning into the unknown requires the total consolidation of personal power and internal fortitude.

attributions.surface_quote: I need all my strength... to leave this world and face the unknown

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of the warrior-traveler is absolute solitude.

attributions.surface_quote: Beyond a certain point, the only joy of a warrior-traveler is his aloneness.

canonical_statement: The elimination of the self is the prerequisite for the cessation of fear across all levels of awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: Forget the self and you will fear nothing, in whatever level of awareness.

canonical_statement: Human beings are fundamentally energetic entities capable of transforming into luminous forms.

attributions.surface_quote: I saw how every one of them turned into a blob of luminosity.

canonical_statement: The transition from physical existence to other states of being is governed by irreversible energetic maneuvers.

attributions.surface_quote: Both of us were caught in an irreversible energetic maneuver.

canonical_statement: The consciousness can undergo cycles of death and revival that are not necessarily tied to biological survival.

attributions.surface_quote: I had died and revived before. I was accustomed to it.

canonical_statement: The human mind can possess 'quasi-memories' of events that have not occurred within the current physical timeline.

attributions.surface_quote: It was a vague knowledge of something that had never happened.

canonical_statement: Physical reality and the state of being 'alive' can be subjectively experienced as a transition or a return from a non-physical state.

attributions.surface_quote: I had jumped into an abyss... I must now be a ghost.

canonical_statement: Personal identity and the perception of a continuous past are contingent upon the stability of the assemblage point.

attributions.surface_quote: My continuity was now broken beyond repair.

canonical_statement: The assemblage point is a focal mechanism that determines which energy fields are perceived as central to awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: The energy fields that were usually on the edge of my assemblage point became central.

canonical_statement: Physical reality and spatial-temporal constraints are subject to alteration through the intentional displacement of the assemblage point.

attributions.surface_quote: I had moved my assemblage point to a position that prevented my death.

canonical_statement: Heightened awareness is a state achieved by shifting the assemblage point to engage energy fields ordinarily peripheral to human perception.

attributions.surface_quote: Heightened awareness as a minute displacement of my assemblage point.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is inherently fragmented, with different segments operating in distinct ranges of activity.

attributions.surface_quote: each fragment lived a specific range of a total scope of activity

canonical_statement: The total scope of a human life is only realized when all cognitive fragments are unified into a single conscious picture.

attributions.surface_quote: events that he experienced in each fragment had to be joined someday

canonical_statement: The nature of reality is not immutable but characterized by eternal fluctuation.

attributions.surface_quote: the world of sorcerers was not an immutable world... but a world of eternal fluctuation

canonical_statement: Individual identity is a construct that obscures a deeper, fragmented reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Who are we really? Certainly not the people all of us have been led to believe

canonical_statement: Human beings are ultimately subsumed by an infinite, non-personal force.

attributions.surface_quote: All of us were warrior-travelers, and all of us had been swallowed by infinity.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of reality is composed of energetic facts, while conventional conceptual frameworks are secondary, non-essential trimmings.

attributions.surface_quote: Only energetic facts were meaningful for me. All the rest were trimmings.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness can be subsumed by a larger, impersonal 'dark sea of awareness' to survive ontological transitions.

attributions.surface_quote: I let the dark sea of awareness swallow me.

canonical_statement: Sorcery is defined as the interruption of the continuity of linear, rational cognition.

attributions.surface_quote: Don Juan had said that that interruption was sorcery.

canonical_statement: Identity is not a fixed, singular construct and can be replaced or exchanged during profound shifts in awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: I truly believed... I was someone else. An exchange had taken place.

canonical_statement: The essence of a teacher can exist as a depersonalized, non-physical force or passageway for the traveler.

attributions.surface_quote: Don Juan was that passageway... void of physicality.

canonical_statement: The nature of the universe is inherently unfathomable to the human mind.

attributions.surface_quote: the universe was indeed unfathomable

canonical_statement: True friendship is defined by the capacity to perceive the underlying essence of an individual beyond their social persona.

attributions.surface_quote: someone who sees through the veneer that covers you

canonical_statement: Human identity is obscured by a superficial veneer that hides one's true origin.

attributions.surface_quote: the veneer that covers you and knows where you really come from
